text:
alex: Quick async standup — SLO / alerting / oncall follow-ups

alex: What I did: trimmed noisy alerts from the eu-west embed pipeline, pushed a tentative rule change (see snippet), ran a small kv-warmup canary overnight.

alex: Blockers: still seeing ~2% tail latency on short-context requests during traffic spikes. Not sure if it's batching or kernel fallback.

alex: Today: tune batcher throttle, follow up with infra on kernel logs, and close the CR for the alert rule.

maya: thanks alex. can you drop the rule link? also pinged infra on kernel logs earlier, they said they saw a few fallback entries around 02:30 UTC.

alex: link: https://rbw.internal/alerts/PR-412 (CR + rationale). rule diff: 
```yaml
alert: HighShortTailLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 200
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page", team: "eng-sre"}
```

sam: noted about fallback kernel. i can add a metric breakpoint to see which requests are falling back to slow path. will add a small probe this afternoon.

kevin: oncall follow-ups: maya — did you get the postmortem items from last night's page? need owner for CI throttling task.

maya: i grabbed the postmortem draft, pushed comments. volunteering to own CI throttling task but will need pair time w/kevin for infra bits.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks. owner mapping: CI throttling -> maya+kevin, batcher tuning -> sam, alert rule PR -> alex.

pagerbot: Incident #2026 closed by alex. Pages: 1 acknowledged, 0 escalated.

sam: small FYI — i noticed KV eviction counters spike right before the latency tail. might be correlated to our prefix cache TTL. investigating.

alex: good catch. if eviction->latency link holds, we can raise prefix TTL or prewarm keys. add to action list.

maya: quick CR ping: alex, your alert rule includes severity: page. can we make it "ticket" for first-tier to reduce noise and only page on repeat? avoids woken on a single blip.

alex: totally. updated the PR to severity: ticket and added a for: 10m clause. adjusting based on feedback.

kevin: reminder: please add runbook link in alert annotations. runbook is https://rbw.runbooks/short-tail-latency. saves time for oncall.

alex: done — annotation added.

sam: planning to run a focused canary at 1700 UTC with smaller batch sizes and injected traffic. will post results in this thread after run.

maya: wrapping blockers: maya -> needs kevin pair for infra changes today, alex -> needs kernel logs parsed (sam offered probe).

alex: thanks all. if anything pages me overnight i'm +1 to temporary fallback to model-small variant on high latency windows. will coordinate with product if we flip.

kevin: noted. I'll sync with product if we trigger fallback in production.

pagerbot: Reminder: oncall rotation tomorrow at 09:00 UTC — maya starts.

alex: closing notes: action items posted to /eng-sre/standup board. CC: @maya @sam @kevin.

maya: :raised_hands: good sync.

sam: will post canary metrics in ~30m.

alex: last — small ask for reviewers: if you have bandwidth please look at PR-412, target merge before EOD. thanks.
